audit_metadata.audit_title: MITRA DRISHTI — DME Model Metric and Clinical Safety Forensic Audit
audit_metadata.architecture: MobileNetV2 Transfer Learning with GlobalAveragePooling and Dense Head
audit_metadata.dataset_provenance: Indian Diabetic Retinopathy Image Dataset (IDRiD) Disease Grading

2.name: High DME Risk Category (Hard Exudates within 1 DD of Fovea)

grade_2_sensitivity_reconciliation.issue: Reported sensitivity 83.33% (40/48) vs Confusion Matrix sensitivity 85.42% (41/48)
grade_2_sensitivity_reconciliation.root_cause: Operating decision rule difference: 3-class argmax selection vs binary triage decision threshold P(Grade 2) >= 0.50.

discrepancy_scan.impact: In argmax, p2 is the largest probability (0.4808 > 0.4764 > 0.0428), scoring a True Positive (41/48 = 85.42%). In binary triage with cutoff 0.50, 0.4808 < 0.50, converting this case to a False Negative (40/48 = 83.33%).

grade_2_specificity_reconciliation.issue: Reported specificity 74.55% (41/55) vs Confusion Matrix specificity 70.91% (39/55)
grade_2_specificity_reconciliation.root_cause: In 3-class argmax, 16 non-Grade-2 scans have Grade 2 as plurality prediction (FP=16, TN=39, Spec=70.91%). At threshold 0.50, two borderline scans fall below 0.50, moving from FP to TN (FP=14, TN=41, Spec=74.55%).

class_weights_investigation.issue: Difference between theoretical raw dataset weights and weights recorded in dme_model_config.json
class_weights_investigation.resolution: Class weights were computed in train_dme_classifier.py AFTER minority class augmentation. Class 1 was 4x oversampled (33 raw -> 132 augmented), which reduced its computed inverse-frequency weight from 3.33 down to 1.8333. The effective combined balancing factor for Class 1 relative to Class 0 is (4 * 1.8333) / (2 * 0.8582) = 4.27x.

dataset_split_and_isolation.split_strategy: Stratified 80/20 train/validation split with fixed seed 42
dataset_split_and_isolation.details: The 103 official testing scans were stored in 'B. Disease Grading/1. Original Images/b. Testing Set' and were never loaded, augmented, or accessed during model training or checkpoint selection. Evaluation was performed strictly post-hoc on the saved model checkpoint.

terminology_corrections_made.previous_claim: Severe / Center-Threatening (CSME), immediate threat to central visual acuity, Urgent Macular OCT Examination & Anti-VEGF / Laser Photocoagulation Consultation
terminology_corrections_made.corrected_text: High Risk Category (Center-Adjacent Exudates), Hard exudates observed within 1 disc diameter of foveal center per IDRiD criteria, Prompt ophthalmologist assessment and Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) confirmation
High DME Risk Category (Hard Exudates within 1 Disc Diameter of Foveal Center)

clinical_safety_and_governance.disclaimer_text: Model prediction for clinical risk stratification only. Slit-lamp biomicroscopy and Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) are mandatory for definitive DME diagnosis.

confidence_and_calibration_audit.calibration_limitation_statement: Deep convolutional networks with Softmax output functions notoriously suffer from uncalibrated overconfidence on small biomedical datasets. An ECE of 12.46% and a 28.2% frequency of >99% confidence predictions indicate that raw Softmax probabilities must NOT be interpreted as true clinical posterior probabilities without post-hoc temperature scaling.

api_and_end_to_end_verification.execution_mode: Asynchronous spawned child process running scripts/dme_inference_engine.py --stdin

unresolved_limitations: Grade 1 sensitivity is depressed at 10.0% due to severe class scarcity (10 test scans) and subtlety of non-center-involving hard exudates on 224x224 downscaled scans.
Softmax probabilities are uncalibrated (ECE 12.46%), producing extreme confidence values (>0.999) on certain scans.
Fundus photographs provide 2D reflectance only; 3D macular edema thickening cannot be definitively measured without cross-sectional OCT imaging.
